Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm forwarding the campsite manager's note about the power connection at site twelve because our arrival is now set for friday afternoon and the hookup details are still a little unclear the pedestal is near the back fence beside the water tap and the manager says the cable should reach from the left side of our van but i measured the space on the map and it looks closer to twenty feet than thirty the site listing says thirty amp service and the note says to bring a standard rv cord with a weatherproof connector we have the cord but the adapter is packed in the blue storage box under the camp kitchen table could you check whether that box is still in the trailer before we leave i also want to mention that the electric panel was replaced last spring and the manager asked us not to use the outlet until the site attendant has checked it on arrival the office closes at six so we should call if our drive is delayed i can forward the note to maya too since she is meeting us there and has the reservation details on her phone", "output": "I'm forwarding the campsite manager's note about the power connection at site twelve because our arrival is now set for Friday afternoon, and the hookup details are still a little unclear. The pedestal is near the back fence beside the water tap, and the manager says the cable should reach from the left side of our van. But I measured the space on the map, and it looks closer to twenty feet than thirty. The site listing says thirty-amp service, and the note says to bring a standard RV cord with a weatherproof connector. We have the cord, but the adapter is packed in the blue storage box under the camp kitchen table. Could you check whether that box is still in the trailer before we leave? I also want to mention that the electric panel was replaced last spring, and the manager asked us not to use the outlet until the site attendant has checked it on arrival. The office closes at six, so we should call if our drive is delayed. I can forward the note to Maya too, since she is meeting us there and has the reservation details on her phone."}]
